aboutContent.title: Care for People, Planet & Peace
aboutContent.content: {"subtitle":"Distinguished Professor of Management","text":"Prof. (Dr.) Bhagwan Singh is a distinguished professor of management, widely recognized as an eminent academician with over 25 years of profound experience in higher education and research. He currently holds a professorship in the Department of Business Administration (DBA), School of Management Sciences (SMS) at the Central University of Jharkhand (CUJ). Throughout his illustrious tenure, he has undertaken pivotal leadership mandates, including serving as Dean, Head, Finance Officer (I/c), Chief Placement Officer (CPO), and Professor-in-Charge of Estate. Furthermore, his administrative acumen is reflected in his appointments to esteemed statutory and apex bodies—such as the Academic Council, Executive Council, and University Court—as well as various high-level confidential committees across central, state, and reputable external organizations.\n\nDr. Singh’s scholarly pursuits lie at the vanguard of Marketing and Information Technology. A prolific author, he has published two influential textbooks on digital and internet marketing, alongside a repository of over 32 research papers in high-impact, reputable journals and numerous contributed book chapters. Anchored by a holistic worldview, his academic endeavors and personal philosophy are deeply dedicated to the harmony of People, Planet, and Peace."}
